Name: DEXTEROUS
Main Effect:
You have advantage when using One-handed weapons.

You learn a number of Novice Martial Moves equal to 2 + your Rank in Duelist.

Whenever you take a long rest, you can use your long rest action to change any number of learned Martial Moves.

At Rank 2, you can learn Adept Martial Moves, and at Rank 3, you gain access to Master Martial Moves.

Name: AGILE
Main Effect: While you have a one-handed weapon in hand your Defense is increased by 1.

Name: FOLLOW UP
Main Effect: While you have a one-handed weapon in hand, your first attack with a one-handed weapon each turn that misses can be rerolled once.

Name: SHARP
Main Effect: You can now use two Martial Moves on the same Weapon Attack, or use one Martial Move just before a Weapon Attack reaction.
